patch.description: Slices 780–781. S780 passed the settled integrated Epic gate: 179/179 test files, 3,161/3,161 tests, and 100% global statement/branch/function/line coverage; build/release/readiness, browser/Electron functional review, actual PDF/ZIP inspection and protected export checks passed. The standard Windows packaged-output path hit EPERM on rename twice; the isolated temporary package path and functional review passed. S781 owns PR #43 merge, main CI/deployment, live preview verification, then canonical board and durable closeout.
